Therefore, running makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare and makepkg --printsrcinfo is safe.
</details>

The wrapper script itself is transparent—it sets an environment variable and executes the binary, which is normal functionality.

No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, unexpected file operations outside the package directory, or dangerous commands are present. The source URLs point to the package's declared upstream, and all operations are consistent with legitimate packaging.
